description: This file defines a custom schema filter for Swagger/OpenAPI in ASP.NET Core, specifically used to modify or exclude certain properties from API schema generation.

classes.name: CustomSchemaFilters
classes.description: A class implementing ISchemaFilter to customize OpenAPI schemas, specifically to exclude the 'CorrelationId' property from schemas.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Method that removes the 'CorrelationId' property from the OpenAPI schema if it exists.
